learn.explainerOffAlt: Because it blocks electron flow, the circuit remains broken and the bulb stays off. 🚫

learn.explainerOn: It allows electric current to pass through, so the bulb glows!
learn.explainerOff: It does not allow electric current to pass through, so the bulb stays off.

materialDescriptions.iron: a metal that allows electricity to flow through it
materialDescriptions.graphite: the 'lead' in pencils, which conducts electricity
materialDescriptions.wood: a natural material that does not conduct electricity
materialDescriptions.plastic: a synthetic material that blocks electricity
materialDescriptions.pencil: the wooden body of a pencil, which does not conduct electricity
materialDescriptions.rubber: used to cover wires because it stops electricity
materialDescriptions.glass: transparent material that does not conduct electricity
